salaryINR.note: L4/L5 band. Do not accept below 6L for a support role in Bengaluru.

playbook.title: Fix the profile before applying
playbook.detail: Headline, About, 3 banner-relevant skills, profile photo, custom URL. Add AWS Cloud Practitioner + Generative AI Fundamentals badges as soon as you pass. Set 'Open to work' to recruiters only.

playbook.title: Rewrite every resume bullet as AR
playbook.detail: Action + Result, with a number. 'Built an AI study tracker in Laravel with 3,200 lines and 10 passing tests' not 'Worked on an app'. Three resume variants: cloud, AI, backend.

playbook.title: Build the recruiter tracker here
playbook.detail: Every application: company, role, link, date, stage, follow-up date, notes. 20 applications a week, not 5.

playbook.title: Apply to the 3 projects
playbook.detail: AccoSpark on AWS and the Bedrock app must be live and demoable before week 8 applications. An interviewer who can click your link is a different conversation.

playbook.title: Referral-first, always
playbook.detail: Message 3 people per week on LinkedIn. A referral is 3-5x more likely to get a screen. Ask specifically: 'Do you know who is hiring cloud engineers at <company>?'

playbook.title: Nail the three standard interviews
playbook.detail: (1) Walk me through your best project. (2) Live scenario: 'a page is slow, how do you debug it'. (3) Behavioural with STAR. Rehearse out loud, on camera, once a week.

playbook.title: Interview-arc follow-up
playbook.detail: After every interview, log 3 things you were asked and update the post or project doc that would have answered it better. Repeat the same error and you deserve the same result.

playbook.title: Target the certificate-free shortlist
playbook.detail: Small-to-mid companies and startups move on portfolio and live-demo ability, not credentials. They also reply faster. Volume matters more than prestige right now.
